HighResolutionMode.ptp_interface_status: Lacks dedicated sub-property tag in Tether / libLmxptpif. Activated solely as DriveMode entry DM_HRS (0x000a) or DM_HANDHELD_HRS (0x0004).

detailed_settings.synthesis_delay: No PTP endpoint in Tether API
detailed_settings.motion_blur_mode: No PTP endpoint in Tether API
detailed_settings.save_1st_normal_picture: No PTP endpoint in Tether API

HighResolutionMode.dat_cam_status: Included in [High Resolution Mode Setting] block within DAT scope (DVQP2839 0148.html), but individual record tag is unmapped without single-variable A/B diff.

ShutterType.category: Shutter Mechanism Selection (Mechanical vs Electronic vs EFCT)
ShutterType.ptp_interface_status: ABSENT from Tether UI and libLmxptpif protocol tables. No LMX_func_api_ShutterType symbol exists.

shutter_speed.function: Controls shutter speed exposure duration or video angle (Tag 0x053A in S5IIX.DAT), not shutter physical mechanism.

silent_mode.function: Silent mode indirectly forces electronic shutter in camera firmware.

ShutterType.dat_cam_status: Confirmed in Save/Restore scope (DVQP2839 0148.html), but individual record tag is unmapped without single-variable A/B diff.

Save1stNormalPicture.ptp_interface_status: ABSENT from Tether UI and libLmxptpif protocol tables.
Save1stNormalPicture.object_delivery_behavior: Camera firmware generates an additional PTP object handle on SD/memory when enabled; Tether reacts passively via EV_OBJCT_ADD (0x10000040) notification.
Save1stNormalPicture.dat_cam_status: Sub-field within [High Resolution Mode Setting] menu block in DAT.

ptp_vs_dat_tag_bridge_verification.conclusion: NO DIRECT 1:1 NUMERICAL OR STRUCTURAL MAPPING EXISTS BETWEEN PTP PROPERTY TAGS AND .DAT RECORD TAGS.

verifiable_evidence.test: Check presence of low-16-bit PTP property tags in S5II.DAT catalog
verifiable_evidence.result: NOT FOUND. Tags 0x001e through 0x0038 do not exist in S5II.DAT.

verifiable_evidence.test: Check presence of low-16-bit PTP property tags in S5II.DAT catalog
verifiable_evidence.result: NOT FOUND. Tag 0x0030 does not exist in S5II.DAT.

verifiable_evidence.test: Inspect DAT Tag 0x0081 (corresponding numerically to PTP DriveMode Set 0x02000081)
verifiable_evidence.actual_content: Small record, declared length 20, payload 14 bytes all 0x00.
verifiable_evidence.result: Payload is entirely zeroed, inconsistent with active DriveMode enum states.
verifiable_evidence.status: REFUTES numerical identity as semantic bridge

verifiable_evidence.test: Inspect PC host software handling of .CAM / .DAT in disassembly
verifiable_evidence.result: Host software treats .CAM/.DAT as an opaque 15MB binary blob and blind-pipes it directly via PTP OpCode 0x9422/0x9423 under subcode 0x800a2. There is ZERO unpacking loop, ZERO tag mapping table, and ZERO parameter translation code in the PC binaries.
verifiable_evidence.status: PROVES host-side opacity; semantic interpretation is 100% confined to camera RTOS/firmware

intra_model_diff_s5ii.limitation: The 84 modifications occurred as a collective batch of video and general production preset adjustments (picture profile, frame rates, audio, button maps). Because multiple settings varied concurrently without a controlled single-variable experiment, no specific tag among the 84 can be mathematically assigned to High-Res or Shutter Type.

isolated_evidence: Tag 0x053A (exclusive to S5IIX): 14 repeated uint16 values of 0x00b4 (180 decimal), corresponding to 180-degree video shutter angle.
Tag 0x0001 (common): 14 repeated uint16 values of 0x004a ('J' for S5II) vs 0x004b ('K' for S5IIX), model hardware identifier.
12 exclusive tags total 304 bytes, matching exact file size difference between S5II and S5IIX.
inter_model_diff_s5ii_vs_s5iix.limitation: The 99 common record differences reflect divergent default profiles and user setups across models, not an isolated single-variable toggle.

missing_materials_for_this_path.material: Single-Variable Laboratory DAT/CAM A/B Sample Pair
missing_materials_for_this_path.description: Two camera setting exports from the identical physical camera where ONLY ONE setting is changed (e.g. High-Res ON vs OFF, or Shutter Type MECH vs ES), exported without changing any other parameter.
missing_materials_for_this_path.why_essential: Because host software does not parse .DAT records, single-variable differential analysis of the binary record hashes is the ONLY deterministic method to identify the true Tag ID without guessing.
